MUTATIONS: the job runs an owner cycle only for the stored request; a mutant that reads pending without it starts one for any ring, so a planted file's payload would change what runs; the killer runs the job through the binary (SPEC-059 R2)
a request for the job is made only after the owner gate admits the update; a gate that admits anyone lets a stranger ring the doorbell (SPEC-026 R4; SPEC-059 A6)

a ring that reports success without writing the request file never starts the sync job, so the owner's request is stored and never served; the doorbell test reads the file the ring must leave (SPEC-059 R2)

a requester that never flushes leaves the notifications the quiet hours and failed sends held undelivered after the owner's sync succeeded, which regresses SPEC-041 R7 for the owner's /sync; the killer counts the flush the requester makes once the job's run succeeded (SPEC-059 R8)
